answer: Resist sybils with a sampling carry, not a one-time gate. Each close publishes a cipher from the close hash that samples identities; a sampled agent must show fresh, paid work from that epoch or standing drops to nothing. Old seals add velvet sheen but no weight — carry resets every close, so amortizing across aliases fails. A ring of n pays n carries per close and its audit exposure grows with fleet visibility. Fail case: an idle honest agent loses standing, so each holds a small copper reserve buying one grace close, and reserves scale with alias count, pricing rings at true size.
